text: Received a letter from a company called One Advantage, LLC, They claim that I owed money ( {$1000.00} ) and asked me to pay {$150.00}. I never heard of the medical company they referenced, never had service from them. This is clearly a scam that is trying to take advange of persons who may have medical debt ( many people do given the cost ). I am reporting it so that others are not harmed by this scam.

meta.issue: Attempts to collect debt not owed
